title: Evolith fact vocabulary — what a rule may declare it needs, and where the truth of it lives
description: GT-716 AC2. Every rule in `*.rules.json` declares `facts`: the facets its check reads, by id from this vocabulary. Both engines derive what they can decide from that one declaration — the native triage class from the facets' provenance, the OPA bundle's reach from the facets its policies read (checked against the declaration at build time). A facet's `provenance` names where the truth of it lives, not how it reaches an engine: an `external` or `supplied` facet under `satellite.*` reaches the OPA engine through `facts.satellite` (GT-694) and never the native one. Provenance rank, most demanding first: runtime > external > supplied > observed — a rule's native class is that of its most demanding facet.

provenances.observed: Readable from the repository tree. The Core derives it: a native handler reads the files, or the OPA input builder emits it. Class when no handler exists yet: `unimplemented-native`.
provenances.supplied: A declaration only the satellite's owners hold — a posture, an intent, a contract nobody else can observe. Reaches OPA through `facts.satellite`; the native engine cannot obtain it. Class: `needs-supplied-facts`.
provenances.external: Held by a system outside the repository — the forge, the issue tracker, a registry, a live database, deployed infrastructure, a telemetry backend. Class: `needs-external-system`.
provenances.runtime: Observable only from the running system or an executed suite — traces, timings, coverage, test results, per-call decisions. Class: `needs-runtime`.

repository.why: The working tree as a native handler reads it — files, directories, manifests, workflows.

staticAnalysis.why: A property of the source an analyser derives (module graph, import edges, SARIF findings) — observed, through an enforcer adapter rather than a file read.

satellitePath.why: The satellite root the run was pointed at.

corePath.why: The Core checkout the run resolved.

satellite.files.why: The satellite's top-level file listing, emitted by the input builder.

satellite.packageJson.why: The satellite's root package manifest, or null when there is none.

satellite.workflows.why: The satellite's CI workflow files as read from `.github/workflows`.

satellite.hasPackageLock.why: Whether a lockfile sits in the tree.

satellite.eventDriven.why: The event-driven configuration file, read from the tree.

satellite.layers.why: Layer structure — framework and infrastructure imports per layer. Static analysis, which belongs to the enforcer seam; the OPA channel receives its result.

core.adrs.why: The Core's decision records, listed from its checkout.

core.cli.why: The Core CLI's build artifacts, tests and documents, as found in the checkout.

core.evidence.why: The Core's evidence documents, read from the checkout.

core.hasPackageLock.why: Whether the Core checkout has a lockfile.

satellite.multiTenancy.why: Whether queries filter by tenant and whether RLS is enabled are not visible in a listing — the owners declare the posture.

satellite.runtime.why: Runtime selection rationale is a declaration about intent, not an observable.

satellite.protocol.why: Which calls use gRPC or REST needs call-graph analysis nobody performs here; the owners declare it.

satellite.openCore.why: The open-core boundary is a declared commercial boundary, not a file fact.

satellite.overridesRationaleDocumented.why: Whether a dependency override carries a written rationale is declared by the owners.

adapter.why: The anti-corruption adapter's contract — schema validation, traceability, compatibility version — is declared by the integration's owners.

context.why: The evaluation context a caller declares for context-aware policies (Definition of Done, compliance baseline, phase).

gate.why: The phase gate under evaluation — its mandatory evidence and blocking criteria — handed in by the pipeline.

evidence.why: The artifacts a caller presents to a phase gate. Nothing presented is a fact the gate fails on, not a reason to abstain.

waiver.why: Waivers a caller presents to a phase gate. None presented is itself the fact.

evaluationDate.why: The date a caller evaluates at, for waiver expiry and evidence age; absent means the age is unknown, which the policies handle.

qualityEvidence.why: ADR-0111 quality evidence a caller presents inline. Nothing presented and an empty set are the same verdict, on both engines.

promotion.why: A knowledge-intake promotion request, declared by the workflow that runs it.

knowledge_id.why: The knowledge candidate under intake, declared by the workflow.

source.why: The knowledge candidate's source class, locator, retrieval date and rights, declared at intake.

source_registry_id.why: The knowledge candidate's registry entry, declared at intake.

review.why: The knowledge candidate's review record, declared at intake.

assessment.why: The knowledge candidate's assessment record, declared at intake.

infrastructure.why: A Helm or sidecar deployment description the caller hands to the infrastructure policies.

origin.why: The origin a caller declares for an infrastructure evaluation.

satellite.git.why: Branch protection, review counts and push history live in the forge, not in the working tree.

satellite.ci.why: Pipeline configuration lives in the CI system, not in the repository tree.

satellite.findings.why: Scanner findings and their ages come from the scanners, not from a directory listing.

satellite.scorecards.why: DORA and SPACE figures come from the delivery pipeline and surveys.

satellite.contracts.why: Satellite contracts mix file facts with governance state — phase approval, deprecation, registered names and Core versions — that the registry holds.

forge.why: Acceptance lives in the VCS host: branch protection, approvals, tags, merge strategy.

issueTracker.why: Acceptance is an issue-tracker state — age, SLA — outside the repository.

registry.why: Acceptance is a record in an external catalog, registry or lineage store.

database.why: Acceptance is a property of a live database — RLS, schema-per-tenant.

deployedInfrastructure.why: Acceptance is a property of deployed infrastructure — service mesh, mTLS, on-call.

telemetryBackend.why: Acceptance is a query against a telemetry or metrics backend.

satellite.testing.why: Test-mix percentages and coverage come from a test run, not from source on disk.

satellite.coreParity.why: It compares the vendor CLI against the Core by running both; not a fact about the tree.

satellite.releaseReadiness.why: Build passes, tests pass and the MCP smoke passes require RUNNING them.

traces.why: Acceptance is an observation of the running system — traces, logs, per-call decisions.

executionMetrics.why: Acceptance is a measured execution property — durations, coverage, isolation at run time.

testExecution.why: Acceptance requires executing the suite or fixtures and comparing outcomes.

user.why: The principal of an MCP tool call, known only at dispatch.

tool_name.why: The MCP tool being called, known only at dispatch.

environment.why: The environment an MCP tool call runs in, known only at dispatch.

coverage_percentage.why: A test-run figure the SDLC coverage policy reads.

maxCyclomaticComplexity.why: An analysis figure a metrics run supplies to the SDLC coverage and engineering-manifesto policies.

criticalCveCount.why: A scanner figure a security scan supplies.

highCveCount.why: A scanner figure a security scan supplies.

technicalDebtRemediationPlanExists.why: Declared alongside the debt metrics of a metrics run.

behaviorChangedWithoutDocUpdate.why: A change-analysis figure a pipeline supplies.

apiPathsWithoutObservability.why: A metrics-run figure over the deployed API.

breakingContractChange.why: A contract-diff result a pipeline supplies.

contractTestsPassed.why: A contract-test result a pipeline supplies.

classLineCount.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

classMethodCount.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

openClosedViolations.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

liskovViolations.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

interfaceSegregationViolations.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

domainImportsInfrastructure.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

duplicateCodeRatio.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

duplicateConfigCount.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

yagniViolations.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

circularDependencies.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

magicNumbersCount.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

prematureAbstractionSignals.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

shotgunSurgeryClassCount.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

shotgunSurgerySignals.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.

spaghettiCodeSignals.why: An engineering-manifesto metric a metrics run supplies.
